summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the spec's seven-step procedure. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test covering all valid and invalid cases, a graph-unchanged check, and non-node input tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed). Design choice: sequences, alternatives, inverses and modifiers are built with the path operators (/, |, ~, * "*"/"+"/"?") so only the Path class is imported, per the spec's allowed-imports list. Not verified: mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the venv, so the type-check and lint gates were not run; line lengths were checked by hand (all within 88). Type-ignore comments were omitted on operator lines and may be needed if the type checker flags them. Nothing was committed.
